APP V1.4.0

Bootstrap expired — stop campaign before renewal · b8edcc6a7cf3… · revision 1
MAINTENANCE
Data Reset

Clear accumulated tracking data without touching coin prep or wallet state. All three actions require the bot to be stopped and ask for confirmation. None of these touch on-chain state or saved settings.

Data Management
?
Each option is independent. Pick the one that matches what you want to reset. The bot must be stopped first.
Reset P&L Counters
Wipes fill history, round-trips, price history, inventory snapshots, and the position baseline. Open offers, coins, and settings are kept.
Reset P&L
Clear Offer History
Deletes all closed, cancelled, and expired offer rows. Live (open) offers remain. Keeps P&L counters and all other data untouched.
Clear History
Full Reset
Both of the above, plus runtime stat counters (opportunity history, watchdog streaks, fill-tracker state). Coin designations, settings, and wallet state are preserved.
Full Reset

What does this bot do?

This bot provides automated offer-book liquidity for Chia CAT tokens. Sage is the wallet and transaction authority; Dexie is the primary attributable offer book; Splash supplies optional peer publication and discovery evidence; Coinset and Spacescan provide corroborating chain context.

How it works — the cycle

The bot runs a complete cycle on the configured interval and refreshes attributable offers, publication discovery, Sage state, and corroborating chain evidence. Confidence transitions can freeze Follow-mode creation immediately and progressively withdraw Follow exposure without trusting an indexer to mutate the wallet. An active Bootstrap campaign follows its separately approved, identity-bound budget and price corridor.

Each cycle runs these steps:

Build a trusted book from fresh attributable Dexie and Splash offers, excluding CATalyst's own offers
Check health - is Sage reachable, is the wallet ready, and are any circuit breakers active?
Detect fills - compare Sage, Dexie, and on-chain evidence before booking fills
Match PnL — pair up buy fills with sell fills to calculate profit
Update inventory — track net position (are we accumulating CAT or XCH?)
Clean expired offers and pre-emptively refresh any expiring within 5 minutes
Evaluate confidence from depth, source health, movement persistence, and manipulation signals
Withdraw safely when confidence is red, then require durable healthy recovery before new exposure
Regular requote if the price has drifted beyond the threshold
Create new offers with tiered sizing, inventory skew, competitor awareness, and pending-cancel guards
Post to Dexie (and optionally Splash P2P) for visibility
Check coins - reconcile locks, classify new outputs, and run adaptive topup when prepared pools get low
Key concepts

Spread: The difference between your buy and sell price, shown as a %. Wider = safer but fewer fills. Narrower = more fills but more risk.

Inventory: Your net position. If people keep buying your CAT, you accumulate XCH (go short CAT). The bot skews spreads to rebalance.

Coins: Chia uses a UTXO model - each offer locks a specific coin. Coin prep and topup keep correctly sized XCH, CAT, dedicated fee, reserve, and ladder coins available so the book can rebuild cleanly.

Data Reset

Clear accumulated tracking data without touching coin prep or wallet state. All three actions require the bot to be stopped and ask for confirmation. None of these touch on-chain state or saved settings.

Data Management
?
Each option is independent. Pick the one that matches what you want to reset. The bot must be stopped first.
Reset P&L Counters
Wipes fill history, round-trips, price history, inventory snapshots, and the position baseline. Open offers, coins, and settings are kept.
Reset P&L
Clear Offer History
Deletes all closed, cancelled, and expired offer rows. Live (open) offers remain. Keeps P&L counters and all other data untouched.
Clear History
Full Reset
Both of the above, plus runtime stat counters (opportunity history, watchdog streaks, fill-tracker state). Coin designations, settings, and wallet state are preserved.

ABOUT
CATalyst

A native desktop app for automated Chia CAT offer-book liquidity from Sage Wallet. Sage is the wallet and transaction authority. Dexie is the primary attributable offer book. Splash provides peer discovery and publication evidence. Coinset and Spacescan provide corroborating chain evidence.

Created by MonkeyZoo
What the app does
Connects to Sage Wallet, prepares offer-sized XCH and CAT coins, builds a tiered buy/sell ladder, publishes independently to Dexie and optional Splash P2P, tracks authoritative fills, and updates confirmed PnL. Follow mode progressively withdraws exposure when attributable market evidence degrades; an explicitly approved, budget-bound Bootstrap campaign can remain active inside its signed corridor.
What's current - public beta
Public beta release flow - The website, installer metadata, and in-app update badge now track the current release so testers can download the latest build from one place.
Sage wallet selection - Startup asks testers to choose the Sage signing wallet/fingerprint on every launch, then runs RPC, version, Spacescan, Splash, Smart Settings, coin prep, and start-guard checks against that wallet.
Offer-book Smart Settings - Smart Settings derives spread, attributable depth, movement persistence, manipulation limits, reserves, tier sizes, fees, and profitability floors from Dexie, Splash, Sage, and corroborating chain evidence.
Confidence and degraded recovery - Green, amber, and red confidence states prevent new Follow-mode exposure when evidence is weak and withdraw inner, middle, then outer Follow offers on a durable 0/3/10-minute schedule. Bootstrap remains limited to the exact approved campaign budget, corridor, wallet, asset, and revision.
Coin prep and topup improvements - Prepared XCH/CAT pools, dedicated fee coins, reserve coins, and topup outputs are classified immediately so live topup does not churn useful coins back into reserve.
Publication discovery - A submission response is only an acknowledgement. CATalyst requires exact rediscovery through Dexie or Splash before treating an offer as public and active.
Beta feedback and diagnostics - Debug Bundle, crash reports, and public issue forms are ready for early testers to report bugs or rough edges in the bot repo.
Dashboard guidance cleanup - Guidance waits for stronger tipping points before showing advice, deduplicates overlapping alerts, and keeps action items separate from lower-confidence advisor notes.
Diagnostics and charts - Market Diagnostics show source health, attributable depth, own-offer exclusions, confidence reasons, withdrawal stage, and chain corroboration without treating an indexer as wallet authority.
Earlier milestones
Desktop shell — native window, system tray, and OS notifications.
Chain corroboration — Coinset and Spacescan evidence can corroborate Sage state without becoming wallet authority.
Hardened safeguards — silent-loss rate alerts, position sanity checks, cancel-storm protection, daily DB↔wallet reconciliation, background-thread liveness watchdog, WAL monitoring, and per-cycle SLA timing.
Startup self-test — checks every active service used by the app (Sage, Coinset, Dexie, Spacescan, and Splash where enabled) and identifies missing capabilities without contacting retired providers.
Settings audit log — every config change is recorded with who/when/what so you can investigate after the fact.
Light mode polish — every panel and modal now reads cleanly on a light background.
PnL statistics — volume, avg fill size, avg trip time, avg profit per trip, open legs panel.
Token identity — canonical ticker and asset identity are shown without loading remote token artwork into the wallet UI.
Important risks
This app can create, cancel, and replace real on-chain offers using Sage Wallet. Market gaps, wallet sync issues, price shocks, bad settings, network delays, stale third-party data, or delayed cancel settlement can still lead to losses, missed fills, or unmanaged exposure.
Disclaimer
Use this software at your own risk. Always test with small size first, review your settings carefully, and monitor live trading. MonkeyZoo is not responsible for users losing funds while using this application.
